$comment: Hand-maintained. Declares the LAYERED governance packages that control this repository and how their integrity is verified. Verified in CI by scripts/check-network-governance.mjs. This file exists separately from handoff-provenance.json on purpose: that file is regenerated wholesale by scripts/sync-handoff.mjs, which rebuilds its object from HANDOFF_VERSION/HANDOFF_SOURCE and preserves only `overrides`, so any layer declaration added there would be silently dropped on the next `pnpm sync:handoff`. Overloading its single handoffVersion string to mean three packages would also make the base-layer provenance check ambiguous.
subordination: Network architecture is ADDITIVE and SUBORDINATE to the production handoff and to the security, privacy, tenant-isolation, authority, resilience and non-regression requirements that precede it. Where a network requirement and a security requirement conflict, the stricter restriction wins and the network requirement yields. No layer below may be weakened to simplify a layer above.

layers.note: The base handoff. Its integrity is verified in CI by `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`, and its generated operational copies at the repository root are verified by scripts/check-handoff-provenance.mjs. handoff-provenance.json describes THIS layer only.
Controlling security layer. Generates no root copies. Its manifest was unverified by CI before N0 — the same gap the audit found in v1.4.0, and it is closed by the same validator.

Network architecture. Additive and subordinate. Installing it authorizes no runtime behavior: no participants, integrations, agents, dispatch, marketplace or settlement activate because a document describes them.
